dct_title_s: Dominican Republic - Subnational Edge-matched Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Dominican Republic administrative level 0-4 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, geodatabase, and geoservice. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-dom); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These layers are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Dominican Republic - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-dom) administrative level 0-2 tables using the ADM0, ADM1, and ADM2_PCODE fields.
